- Goals: Build technique, establish solid strength foundation, moderate volume.

- Goals: Consolidate gains, maximize density, introduce conditioning while maintaining strength

1RM testing plan (end of Phase 3, Weeks 7–9)
- Purpose: Gauge progress and recalibrate loads for Phase 4
- Lifts: Bench Press, Back Squat, Deadlift; Overhead Press (optional)
- Protocol: 3–4 warm-up sets, then 1–2 attempts at a 1RM per lift with rest ~3–5 minutes between attempts when possible
- Testing order (typical): Bench Press, Squat, Deadlift, (Overhead Press optional)
- Safety: Spotters; proper warm-up; stop on any form breakdown
- Post-test: Update Phase 4 plate math, recalculate training loads using new 1RM values, and adjust weekly progression targets accordingly
